narrative: The morning's leaf turned down on the older ones. Edges only. No figure written on an edge. The Chaucer is closed now, at the left. The pile of his own leaves is at the right, still unopened. His hands are off both. Behind the pile, the letter, flat, no wafer. He does not draw it forward.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the edges and did not count them.
